E9. Pregnant women, breastfeeding women, those planning pregnancy in the near future, or individuals who cannot comply with contraception during trial.
E10. Participants in or previously involved in other clinical studies.
E11. Individuals unwilling or unable to comply with follow-up or unwilling to participate.

Inclusion Criteria:
I1. 18 to 90 years of age

E1. Severe hypersensitivity reaction to gadobutrol or ferumoxytol.

E3. Any MRI-non-compatible implanted device, prosthetic or pacemaker.
E4. Known or suspected metastatic disease.
E5. Women with active pregnancy, lactation or plans to conceive
E6. Untreated urinary tract infection
E7. Known urethral stricture disease that would prohibit placement of foley catheter.
E8. Any other conditions considered as unacceptable risk by the treating physician

final_reasons: IPF를 시사할 수 있는 증상과 영상 소견은 있으나 확진 여부가 불분명하고, 치료 상태와 FVC·DLCO 등 주요 선정 기준에 필요한 정보도 부족함.
IPF 의심 증상 외에 다른 정보가 부족함
confusions:
- IPF를 시사하는 증상과 영상 소견이 있어도, IPF 진단 자체가 명시되어 있지 않으면 어디까지 추론해도 되는지 헷갈렸음. 특히 점차 악화되는 호흡곤란(progressive dyspnea), 마른기침(dry cough), 곤봉지(clubbing of the fingers), 양측 폐 하부의 망상 음영과 벌집모양 소견(bilateral basal reticular opacities with honeycombing)이 있어도 IPF 확진으로 볼 수는 없음.
- E2의 폐기종(emphysema)과 섬유화(fibrotic changes) 범위를 HRCT에서 비교하는 기준은 의학적·영상의학적 배경지식이 부족하면 해석이 어려웠음. 환자 설명에는 honeycombing 등 섬유화 소견은 있지만 폐기종 범위 정보는 없어서 직접 판정하기 어려웠음.
- FVC와 DLCO처럼 수치 기반 폐기능 기준은 호흡곤란 증상만으로는 추정할 수 없어서, 판단을 위해서는 실제 검사 수치가 반드시 필요했음. 
- 마른기침(dry cough)이 있어도 그것이 치료가 필요한 하기도 감염(lower respiratory tract infection)을 의미하는지는 알 수 없어서, 증상과 진단 기준을 구분해야 했음.

cases.patient: A 60-year-old woman presents with progressive dyspnea, dry cough, and clubbing of the fingers. Chest CT reveals bilateral basal reticular opacities with honeycombing.
cases.criteria:
[임상시험 NCT07299695 기준]
Study locations: Greece. Age 18 Years - no maximum. Sex ALL.

Inclusion Criteria:
I1. Patients ≥ 18 years of age
I2. Patients with IPF diagnosis that fulfils ATS/ERS Consensus Criteria.
I3. Patients hospitalised with a definite or suspected AE-IPF diagnosis, as defined by the international working group criteria and as ascertained by the responsible Primary Investigator. / The criteria of IPF-AE are as follows: / Previous or concurrent diagnosis of IPF / Acute worsening or development of dyspnoea typically < 1 month duration / Computed tomography with new bilateral ground-glass opacity and/or consolidation superimposed on a background pattern consistent with usual interstitial pneumonia pattern / Deterioration not fully explained by cardiac failure or fluid overload Patients who fail to meet all 4 criteria due to missing computed tomography should be considered as having "suspected Acute Exacerbation". / If the diagnosis of IPF is not previously established, this criterion can be met by the presence of radiologic and/or histopathologic changes consistent with usual interstitial pneumonia pattern on the current evaluation. / If no previous computed tomography is available, the qualifier "new" can be dropped from the third AE-IPF criterion.
I4. Patient able to understand and sign a written informed consent form. In case of incapacity of the patient, the written informed consent form will be signed by the patients' legally authorized representative.

Exclusion Criteria:
E1. Patients with acute worsening due to uncontrolled heart failure or pulmonary embolism.
E2. Patients with known hypersensitivity to corticosteroids, IVIG or any component of the study treatment.
E3. Patients with known IgA deficiency (IgA level <7 mg/dL)- to preclude IVIG reactions.
E4. Patients without a definite diagnosis of IPF or AE-IPF based on clinical, radiological, laboratory evaluation, and multidisciplinary discussion.
E5. Patients with active malignancy or currently receiving cancer treatment, except for basal cell or squamous cell skin cancer or low-risk prostate cancer (T1 or T2a stage with PSA <10 ng/dL). These criteria are aligned with current guidelines.
E6. Patients that have received treatment for >14 days within the preceding month with >20mg daily prednisone (or equivalent) or any treatment during the last month with immunosuppressants (e.g., cyclophosphamide, mycophenolate etc.) according to already published therapeutic protocols or > 1 mg/kg/d from more than 7 days in the last 15 days.
E7. Patients participating to another interventional clinical trial.
E8. Patients with documented pregnancy or lactation.
E9. Patients under tutorship or curatorship.
E10. Patients deprived of liberty or under court protection.
E11. Patients who refuse to participate or decline to provide written informed consent.

- I2의 ATS/ERS 기준(ATS/ERS Consensus Criteria)이 구체적으로 어떤 요소를 포함하는지 시트만으로는 알 수 없어, 환자 설명만으로 IPF 진단 기준 충족 여부를 판단하기 어려웠음.
